**UI QA Review: Usage & Spend Meter**

| Status | Category | Issue | Location / Detail |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **FAIL** | **Clipped/Overlapping Text** | **Y-axis label collision**: The top Y-axis label `8.9k` is partially overlapping with the chart title "Daily usage — last 30 days". | Chart area, top-left corner |
| **FAIL** | **Chart Rendering** | **Extreme data spike clipping**: The final day's bar (instance-hours) and line (requests) shoot up drastically, causing the top of the bar and the data point/label (`51`) to be clipped by the chart container's top boundary. The Y-axis scale (jumping from ~8 to 8.9k) suggests an outlier or rendering error. | Chart area, far right |
| **WARN** | **Alignment** | **Inconsistent vertical rhythm**: The four metric cards ("Instance-Hours", "Proxied Requests", etc.) appear to have slightly different internal text padding or baseline alignments for their sub-labels compared to the main values. | Metric Cards row |
| **WARN** | **Contrast/Readability** | **Low-contrast sub-text**: The descriptive text under the main metrics (e.g., "real uptime × live instances...") and the table header row use a very dark grey (`#888` approx) against the black background, which may fail WCAG AA contrast requirements for small text. | Metric cards & Table headers |
| **PASS** | Layout/Structure | No obvious broken layout, missing icons, or empty states detected. Sidebar navigation and top header are well-aligned. | Global |
| **PASS** | Functionality (Visual) | Toggle buttons (7d/30d/90d), active states (Usage & Spend Meter), and status indicators (Online/Live) are visually distinct and correctly rendered. | Header & Sidebar |

### Summary
The view fails QA primarily due to **text overlapping** in the chart header and **severe graphical clipping** of the data spike on the final day of the usage chart. The chart needs a dynamic Y-axis adjustment or a scroll/zoom feature to accommodate the outlier without cutting off the visual elements.
